DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Dystonia secondary to Risperidone use.

Based on your history of starting risperidone two months ago and the characteristic symptoms of stiffness, jaw locking, and potential tongue protrusion, this is consistent with drug-induced acute dystonia. We will likely treat this with an anticholinergic medication, but do you have any history of allergies to antihistamines or prior reactions to similar drugs?
